# dsh-su — SketchUp bridge for DeepSeek Harness

A **DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin** that turns a live SketchUp Pro session into agent
tools: run Rub

y task scripts, inspect the model, save `.skp` files and capture viewport
images — all over a local

JSON-lines TCP bridge, with the companion SketchUp extension
installed and updated automatically.

一个把 **SketchUp 2023** 接入 **DeepSeek Harness** 的插件：DSH Agent 可以直接驱动一个
常驻的 SketchUp 会话（跑 Ruby 脚本、查模型、存

`.skp`、截图），配套的 SketchUp 扩展由插件
自动安装/更新。
## Features

- **8 agent tools** — `su_status`, `su_install_extension`, `su_ensure`, `su_run`,
`su_eval`, `su_sav

e`, `su_capture`, `su_stop`.
- **Warm SketchUp session** — launch once, then every task is a short b

ridge round-trip
(typically 10–100 ms) instead of restarting the app.
- **Self-contained SketchUp ex

tension** — installed into `Plugins\` on first use
(also shipped as a `.rbz`); starts the bridge aut

omatically and adds
*Extensions → DSH Bridge* (status / logs / restart).
- **Bundled metric modellin

g kit** — task scripts `require 'su_kit'` for boxes,
cylinders, extrusions, tags, materials, cameras

, screenshots and validation helpers
(metres in, metres out).
- **Bundled skill** `sketchup-modeling

` — workflow + SketchUp 2023 / Ruby 2.7 pitfalls.
- **Safe by default** — tools are workspace-restri

cted, refuse silent overwrites, and
refuse to reset a document when another bridge is already runnin

ed, refuse silent overwrites, and
refuse to reset a document when another bridge is already running.
## Architecture
[代码示例省略，未执行]

SketchUp's Ruby API is single-threaded: the socket thread only does I/O, and model
commands are queu

ed through `UI.start_timer` onto the main thread. The extension also
handles SketchUp 2023's quirk t

hat Ruby plugins are **not** loaded while the welcome
screen is open — the plugin therefore launches
SketchUp **with a template `.skp`**.
## Requirements

- Windows 10/11
- SketchUp Pro **2023** (developed and tested with 23.1.315, Ruby 2.7.7)
- DeepSeek

Harness with a desktop profile (`~/.dsh/profiles/desktop`)
- Node.js ≥ 22.12 (provided by DSH)
## Install
### 1. Add the DSH plugin
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Restart DeepSeek Harness. The tools listed above appear in the tool set and the
`sketchup-modeling`
skill is registered.
### 2. SketchUp side (automatic)

Nothing to do: `su_ensure` / `su_install_extension` copy the bundled extension into
`%APPDATA%\Sketc

hUp\SketchUp 2023\SketchUp\Plugins\` and update it when the version
changes. A SketchUp instance tha

t is already open must be restarted once so the
extension loads.

Manual alternative: install `dist/dsh-su-sketchup-<version>.rbz` through
*Extension Manager*. Build
it with `python scripts/build-artifacts.py`.

`sketchupExecutable` and `templatePath` are optional: the plugin probes common install
locations (`P

rogram Files`, `D:\su`, `SU_EXE` / `SU_TEMPLATE` environment variables)
and reports what it found in

and reports what it found in `su_status`.
## Tools
| tool | what it does |

| `su_status` | bridge health, active model, extension version, detected paths, hints |
| `su_instal

l_extension` | copy/update the SketchUp extension in `Plugins\` |
| `su_ensure` | install extension,

reuse or launch SketchUp, wait for the port, set units to metres |
| `su_run` | run a `.rb` task sc

ript inside SketchUp; returns `$dsh_result` |
| `su_eval` | evaluate a Ruby snippet; returns `$dsh_r

esult` |
| `su_save` | save the document as `.skp` (workspace-restricted, no silent overwrite) |
| `

su_capture` | write a viewport PNG (workspace-restricted, no silent overwrite) |
| `su_stop` | quit
the SketchUp instance that owns the bridge |

`su_kit` API: `reset units tag use_tag box cylinder polygon_extrude polyline arc_2d
group erase_all

smooth_curves material paint camera zoom_extents dolly_out capture
bbox_m counts summary save export

`, plus helpers `Chrono box_f seg_box_f cyl_f sphere_f
glass_f edge_hide! text3d white_studio! shado

w_setup! frame_view! sanity_bounds!
deep_counts`.
## Protocol
One JSON object per line over TCP (`127.0.0.1:47311`):

Commands: `ping info setup reset run eval save capture open new reload quit`.
The extension log live

s in `%LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh-su\logs\bridge.log`; `ready.json` holds
the active port and SketchUp/Ruby v

OCALAPPDATA%\dsh-su\logs\bridge.log`; `ready.json` holds
the active port and SketchUp/Ruby versions.
## Tests
[代码示例省略，未执行]

`test/integration.mjs` and `test/tools-e2e.mjs` refuse to run while another bridge is
answering, so

they never touch a document you have open; they launch and quit their own
SketchUp instance. Set `SU
_EXE` / `SU_TEMPLATE` / `SU_PORT` to override detection.
## Build artifacts
[代码示例省略，未执行]

`scripts/build-artifacts.py` packages the extension into `.rbz` and the plugin into a
zip. The exten
sion Ruby files are committed, so building is optional.

[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Uninstall

1. DSH: remove `dsh-su` from the profile `dependencies` and `dsh.profile.bundles`,
run `pnpm install

`, restart DSH.
[该节后续省略]
## Limitations

- One bridge per machine: a single SketchUp instance owns port `47311`; other instances
need a resta

rt to take over. `su_ensure` reports when it started a new instance.
- Only SketchUp 2023 is tested

(Ruby 2.7). Newer SketchUp versions should mostly work
but are unverified.
- The bridge is local-onl

y (`127.0.0.1`) and has no authentication: treat it as a
development tool run by the same user.
